chose: In a spoken cards essay, a chapter's title and chapter mark belong to its first scene only; later scenes of the same chapter carry no chapter line, so nothing says it twice and the chapter card stays silent.
options: a chapter's first scene carries its title, the rest none
gray: The owner ruled that chapter cards are silent, while spoken cards had every scene's host say its chapter line, so a chapter spanning scenes was said twice and marked twice. One scene per chapter would bend the essay's shape to the schema.
undo: Make chapter required on every scene again, or split essays one scene per chapter.
